findings.description: After `req.reject(requeue=False)` the handler no longer returns. `eta` stays None and execution falls through to the non-ETA path, which calls `task_reserved(req)`, the callbacks and `handle(req)`, so the already-rejected task is executed immediately. The message is rejected and may also be executed, and the ack/reject may happen twice. The task also runs without its ETA.
findings.title: Missing return after rejecting task with invalid ETA

findings.description: The removed `mark_as_failure` call stored the failure in the backend. Now the task is rejected without recording any result, so clients waiting on the result never see the failure and the task stays PENDING.
findings.title: Task failure no longer recorded in result backend
